author: National Geographic
description:
See why Maine is a fly fisher’s paradise with National Geographic photographer, Kiliii Yuyan. Once you've mastered your cast on the water, explore a pottery studio in the woods to see how foraged local gems are melted into unique, handcrafted ceramics.

Come back next week to see more of Kiliii's adventures in our Maine Mondays series.
